KEY ENGLISH TEST for Schools

                                          LISTENING SAMPLE TEST 2
                                                    TAPESCRIPT

Cambridge Assessment English – Key for Schools Listening Test. Sample Test 2.
There are five parts to the test. You will hear each piece twice.

We will now stop for a moment.
Please ask any questions now because you must NOT speak during the test.

Now look at the instructions for Part One.

Pause 05”

For each question, choose the correct answer.

Pause 02”

Look at question one.

Pause 05”

     1 When is the last day of school?

              M2: Do you finish school on the third of July, Jamie? I want to book our
                       holiday. There’s a flight the day after that.

              M: I’ll have to check. I think it’s the fifth. . . Yes, that’s right, Dad.
              M2: Great. I’ll book the flight that leaves on the sixth then.
              M: OK.

     Pause 05"
     Now listen again.
     Repeat
     Pause 05"

     2 What is Max bringing to the class party?

              F: Max, I’m making some cookies for our class party tomorrow. What are
                       you taking?

              M1: That really nice lemonade from the supermarket in town. Do you think
                       two bottles are enough or should I ask Mum to get another one?

              F: That’s fine because I know Gerry is bringing some apple and mango
                       juice.

              M: Great, I love mango!

     Pause 05"

                                                                  1

Now listen again.
Repeat
Pause 05"

3 What will Sarah send her aunt?

         M2: Good news Sarah! I've just heard from your uncle Kevin. Aunt Gemma
                  has had a baby girl.

         F: Great Dad! Shall I send her an email or text her to say
                  'congratulations'?

         M2: Why don't you send them a nice card instead? That would be more
                  special than a text message.

         F: OK. Good idea.

Pause 05"
Now listen again.
Repeat
Pause 05"

4 What's Rosa doing now?
         (teenage girl and boy on phone)

         M: Hi Rosa. What are you doing?
         F: Well, I went to the swimming pool earlier this afternoon and at the

                  moment I'm having a pizza with my sister.
         M: Oh, OK. Do you want a game of table tennis? We've just put the table in

                  our garden.
         F: Great idea. I'll be there in about half an hour.

Pause 05"
Now listen again.
Repeat
Pause 05"

5 When is Anna's school trip?

         M2: Is your school trip on Tuesday, Anna?
         F1: Actually, it's on Thursday Dad – it was Tuesday, but they had to change

                  the day because of our school sports day.
         M2: Oh, I see. Well, don't forget we're going to your aunt's after school on

                  Wednesday.
         F1: Don't worry Dad. I won't!

Pause 05"
Now listen again.
Repeat
Pause 05"

                                                            2

That is the end of Part One.
Pause 10"

                                                                  3

Now look at Part Two.
678910
For each question, write the correct answer in the gap. Write one word, or a
number, or a date, or a time. Look at questions 6 – 10 now. You have
10 seconds.

Pause 10"

You will hear a girl, Jan, leaving a phone message about a penfriend.

F1 Hi, it’s Jan.

I’ve had another email from my penfriend. She knows a girl called Suzi who
wants to write to someone here too. Would you like to write to her?

Suzi’s living in Japan at the moment because of her Dad’s work, but she’s
from China, actually. My penfriend and Suzi went to school together and
they’ve been friends for eleven years - they’re both fourteen, a year older than
us.

When Suzi finishes school she’s going to go to university and hopes to be a
teacher one day, like her mother. Her father’s a doctor.

Suzi’s learning English at school and she’s got a computer so you can email
her easily. My penfriend says Suzi loves sport, especially tennis, but she also
sometimes plays basketball and football. When she’s at home, she enjoys
cooking. She eats a lot of rice, but she likes chicken best, just like you!

Come to my house later and we can email them both. Bye.

                                                         162 words

Pause 05"
Now listen again.
Repeat
Pause 05"

That is the end of Part Two.
Pause 10"

                              4

Now look at Part Three.
1112131415
Pause 05"
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at questions 11 – 15 now.
You have twenty seconds.
Pause 20"
You will hear two friends talking about their plans for a party at the girl’s
house.

(M = about 16 F = about 16 – Antipodean?)
F: You know we want people to wear special clothes to the party? Well, what

         about people dressing like clowns?

M: Or wearing different sports clothes? Oh, (slight pause) I know – like animals –
         that would be really funny!

F: Awesome!
M: You look tired. I’m really excited about the party. Are you?

F: I couldn’t sleep, thinking and worrying about the party plans. You know, the
         food, music, games. I don’t want people to feel bored.

M: It’ll be great! Now, what about the food? A barbecue perhaps?

F: But it might rain.
M: Yes, that’s true. And nobody likes sandwiches. But pizzas are always really

         popular!
F: You’re right. I’ll ask mom to order some.

M: Great!
F: Also, the band can’t play at the party now.

M: Why? Is your dad thinking about the neighbours and noise?
F: Actually it’s Ben, the guitar player. He’s got a bad cold.

M: Oh no! And they were happy to play for free! But I’ve got music. (pause)
         Anyway, what time’s the party going to end?

F: Mom said ten thirty, but I said eleven and she said yes.

M: Good. The last bus is at eleven fifteen. People can catch that.

                                                                  5

180 words

Pause 05"
Now listen again.
Repeat
Pause 05"

That is the end of Part Three.

Pause 10"

                                6

Now look at Part Four.
Pause 05"
For each question, choose the correct answer.
Pause 05”

16 You will hear a boy talking about his father. What job does the boy’s
         father do?

M:         My dad cycles to work. When he had a problem with his car, it took

           so long for the guys at the garage to fix it that Dad started using his

           bike. There are showers at his office so he can change before he
           has meetings with his factory staff. He definitely looks fitter now than

           in old holiday photos!

                                                64 words

Pause 05"

Now listen again.

Repeat

Pause 05"

17 You will hear two friends talking about a sports accident. Where has the
         girl just come from?

M:         Great goal, Sophie. You beat the other team! But did you hurt your

           arm?

F:         Yeah, it’s my elbow.

M:         Don’t you need to go to hospital?

F:         Coach says I should ask the school nurse for a bandage. But I forgot

           to pick up my things! They’re near the athletics track, under the tree!

M:         Don’t worry, I’ll get them for you.

                                                56 words

Pause 05"

Now listen again.

Repeat

Pause 05"

18 You will hear a boy leaving a message for his friend. Why did he phone
         his friend?

         M1: Hi Mary! Sorry you aren’t there. I got your email with the answer to
                    that complicated science question. Thanks. Now, what do you think
                    about this? Let’s work on the English Project together. Can you
                    come round next weekend? Text me before the end of today to say
                    which day is best.
                                                                                                     53 words

Pause 05"
Now listen again.

                                   7

Repeat
Pause 05"

19 You will hear a mother and her daughter, Anna, talking about some
         shoes. What does Anna say about the shoes?

         F2: Do you like your new school shoes, Anna? They were very
                    reasonably priced.

         F1: They’re OK mum but I really wanted blue ones.
         F2: I know blue’s in fashion but, they didn’t have ones in your size,

                    remember? It’s important that they fit and don’t hurt your feet!
         F1: Well, I can definitely wear them all day at school – they’ll be fine.
         F2: Good.

                                                                                                     60 words
Pause 05"
Now listen again.
Repeat
Pause 05"

20 You will hear two students talking about a new teacher. What do they
         say about the new teacher?

F:         Is the new science teacher married?

M:         I don’t know. He didn’t say anything about himself, only that he

           studied physics at university. He didn’t really talk very much in class,

           and he never smiled!

F:         Maybe he’s shy. I know he plays basketball. He’s the right height.

           His head nearly hit the top of the door frame when he walked into

           class!

                                                60 words

Pause 05"
Now listen again.

Repeat

Pause 05"

That is the end of Part Four.

Pause 10"

                                 8

Now look at Part Five.
2122232425
Pause 05”

For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at questions 21 – 25 now.
You have 15 seconds.

Pause 15”

You will hear Chloe telling a friend which school clubs she is going to this term.

M: Hello, Chloe. Which school clubs are you going to this term?
F1: Well, I’ve got dance club on Mondays.
M: Oh. How about coming to computer club on Tuesday evenings?
F: I’m not free then because I go to a club where I can play tennis and basketball.

         Anyway, computer club sounds boring.
M: What about Wednesday?
F: I’ve already got a club that day playing my guitar with other people. We practise in the

         school theatre.
M: The film club on Thursdays is good.
F: I love films but there’s a club where I can learn to paint and draw – so I’m doing that

         then. I can watch films at home.
M: You’re busy.
F: Yes, and on Fridays there’s a club where I’m learning to use a camera. We’re working

         on a project about sports.
M: And on Saturdays?
F: I’d like to be an actor, so I go to a club where we do plays twice a year.
M: Oh I’d like to do that.

                                                                                                               157 words

Pause 05"
Now listen again.
Repeat
Pause 05"

That is the end of Part Five.

Pause 10"

You now have six minutes to write your answers on the answer sheet.
Pause 05’
*Ping*
You have one more minute.
Pause 01’
*Ping*

That is the end of the test.
